name: opencode-auto-handoff
description: OpenCode 2.x plugin: cross-session relay tool handoff_to - creates a fresh session born on a specified agent post with that agent's configured model applied (falls back to the host default when the agent has none or the model is unavailable), injects a successor-oriented six-section thin handoff, and delivers the task prompt. Includes a TUI auto-follow half and a right-side relay-chain panel (one line per hop, click/enter to jump).
